Tests that LLM max_concurrency is accepted independently of the extraction thread budget

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const xberg = @import("xberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/report.txt\"}", "{\"captioning\":{\"llm\":{\"max_concurrency\":2,\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o\"},\"min_image_area\":1000},\"concurrency\":{\"max_threads\":8}}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
